## 3/14/2023

```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
#' # Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(5)
n <- 60
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = 2, k = c(1, 1), angles = TRUE)
plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", pch = 16
)
sdetorus::torusAxis()
clusters <- samp_1
plot_MDS(clusters, angular = TRUE)


```

```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
#' # Straight trends on (S^1)^3
set.seed(100)
n <- 60
samp_2 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = 3, k = c(0, 1, 2), angles = TRUE)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_2,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), zlim = c(-pi, pi),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_2
invisible(plot_MDS(clusters, angular = TRUE))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
#' # Small-circle trends on (S^2)^2
set.seed(20)
n <- 60
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = 2, sigma = 0.05)
layout(matrix(c(1, 2), 1))

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
clusters <- cbind(samp_3[, , 1], samp_3[, , 2])
plot_MDS(clusters, c(2, 2), angular = TRUE)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
#' # Spiral trends on (S^2)^2
set.seed(20)
n <- 60

samp_4 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = 2, c = 3, spiral = TRUE, sigma = 0.05)
layout(matrix(c(1, 2), 1))

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_4[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),

)

  samp_4[, , 2],

)
```

## 3/21/2023

```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
#' # Small circle trends on (S^2)^2 times (S^1)^3, almost all variance along first two spheres.
set.seed(20)
n <- 60
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = 2, sigma = 0.05)
samp_4 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = 3, k = rep(0, 3), sigma = 0.03)
layout(matrix(c(1, 2), 1))

plot( samp_4[, , 1],xlim = c(-1,1), ylim = c(-1,1),col = rainbow(n),pch=16)
plot( samp_4[, , 2],xlim = c(-1,1), ylim = c(-1,1),col = rainbow(n),pch=16)

clusters <- cbind(samp_3[, , 1], samp_3[, , 2], samp_4[, , 1], samp_4[, , 2], samp_4[, , 3])
plot_MDS(clusters, c(2, 2, 1, 1,1), angular = TRUE)
```
```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
#' # Small circle trends on (S^2)^3, almost all variance along first sphere.
set.seed(20)
n <- 60
nspheres <- 3
k<-500
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n=n, r = 1, sigma = 0.05)
clusters <- samp_3[, , 1]

for (i in c(2:nspheres)) {
  clusters <- cbind(clusters,rotasym::r_vMF(n,c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1,3)),k))

}
plot_MDS(clusters, rep(2,nspheres), angular = TRUE)


```
